primary_claims.description: Held-out R2 and residual ICC are reported for L0-L6 by element under non-independent CV.
Proxy importance is measured by out-of-fold block deltas, with linear relaimpo as a secondary diagnostic.
Target/source shuffles, scrambled proxies, self/bonded toggles, and sign-control eligibility are reported.
